title: Pizza Separation
statementMd:
Students Vasya and Petya are studying at the BSU (Byteland State University). At one of the breaks they decided to order a pizza. In this problem pizza is a circle of some radius. The pizza was delivered already cut into $*n*$ pieces. The $*i*$-th piece is a sector of angle equal to $*a*_{*i*}$. Vasya and Petya want to divide all pieces of pizza into two *continuous* sectors in such way that the difference between angles of these sectors is minimal. Sector angle is sum of angles of all pieces in it. Pay attention, that one of sectors can be empty.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 360$)  — the number of pieces into which the delivered pizza was cut.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 360$)  — the angles of the sectors into which the pizza was cut. The sum of all $*a*_{*i*}$ is 360.

## Output

Print one integer  — the minimal difference between angles of sectors that will go to Vasya and Petya.

## Note

In first sample Vasya can take $1$ and $2$ pieces, Petya can take $3$ and $4$ pieces. Then the answer is $|(90 + 90) - (90 + 90)| = 0$.

In third sample there is only one piece of pizza that can be taken by only one from Vasya and Petya. So the answer is $|360 - 0| = 360$.

In fourth sample Vasya can take $1$ and $4$ pieces, then Petya will take $2$ and $3$ pieces. So the answer is $|(170 + 10) - (30 + 150)| = 0$.

Picture explaning fourth sample:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7aeb1713868b7fb0ae534eafef943af97abd11ae.png)

Both red and green sectors consist of two adjacent pieces of pizza. So Vasya can take green sector, then Petya will take red sector.
statementZhMd:
学生 Vasya 和 Petya 就读于 BSU（Byteland State University）。在一次课间休息时，他们决定订一张披萨。在本题中，披萨是一个半径任意的圆。披萨送到时已经被切成了 $*n*$ 块。第 $*i*$ 块是一个圆心角为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的扇形。Vasya 和 Petya 想要将披萨的所有块分成两个*连续*的扇形，使这两个扇形的角度之差尽可能小。一个扇形的角度等于其中所有披萨块的角度之和。请注意，其中一个扇形可以为空。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 360$）——送来的披萨被切成的块数。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 360$）——披萨被切成的各个扇形的角度。所有 $*a*_{*i*}$ 的总和为 360。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——分给 Vasya 和 Petya 的两个扇形的角度之差的最小值。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，Vasya 可以拿第 1 块和第 2 块，Petya 可以拿第 3 块和第 4 块。此时答案为 $|(90 + 90) - (90 + 90)| = 0$。

在第三个样例中，披萨只有一块，因此只能由 Vasya 和 Petya 中的一人拿走。答案为 $|360 - 0| = 360$。

在第四个样例中，Vasya 可以拿第 1 块和第 4 块，Petya 则拿第 2 块和第 3 块。因此答案为 $|(170 + 10) - (30 + 150)| = 0$。

第四个样例的图示：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7aeb1713868b7fb0ae534eafef943af97abd11ae.png)

红色和绿色扇形都由两块相邻的披萨组成。因此，Vasya 可以拿绿色扇形，Petya 则拿红色扇形。
